# additional comments
New separate PR for the `qpose14_r55_segactions_minp` payload. This uses embedded SegNet tile-action corrections and fixed no-header single-blob packing. The archive is hosted externally as a release asset and is not committed to the repo.

Latest packaging pass keeps the smaller equivalent QZS3 model serialization and uses a score-pruned SegNet tile-action subset selected from a larger candidate pool. H200 CUDA/DALI validation improved SegNet from `0.00060686` to `0.00060529` with PoseNet essentially unchanged.

reviews.body: ## Pull request overview Adds a new submission decoder for `qpose14_r55_segactions_minp`, extending the existing qpose-style inflator with support for packed payload variants and embedded SegNet tile-action corrections so the external `archive.zip` can be inflated into raw frames for evaluation. **Changes:** - Adds a submission-specific `inflate.sh` entrypoint that matches the repo’s evaluation contract. - Adds a large `inflate.py` decoder that reconstructs the model, masks, poses, optional side-data, and raw output frames. - Extends packed-payload handling with embedded SegNet tile-action data and fallback logic for short mask streams. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `submissions/qpose14_r55_segactions_minp/inflate.sh` | Thin wrapper that forwards evaluator arguments into the Python inflator. | | `submissions/qpose14_r55_segactions_minp/inflate.py` | Full inflator implementation for this submission, including payload parsing, model reconstruction, optional corrections, and raw frame generation. | --- 💡 Add Copilot custom instructions for smarter, more guided reviews.
